title: Briefing for 2026-11-13
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-13: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.

Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight. China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade. 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong. A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect.
global: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil. Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks. Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?. Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland. Australian footballers will not be charged after hotel incident, police say. Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group.
philippines: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. [Market Rider] Quick fixes to relieve hurting households from high power costs. ASEAN who’s who: Regional, global leaders converge in Manila for year-end summit.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
